title: Worker Memory and Copy-Elimination Disposition for Direct Forcing Views

interpretation.benefit: The candidate removes three value-refresh copies per prepared interval and removes their worker-owned payload while the direct view is active.
interpretation.multiswap_significance: The saving does not multiply by hundreds of thousands of logical columns because these buffers are already worker-owned and reused in F-PE09.
interpretation.architecture_cost: The candidate introduces explicit TARGET/alias lifetime semantics and an additional backend mode with fail-closed lifetime obligations.
interpretation.tradeoff: Within the frozen V1 design the memory saving is bounded and worker-scaled, while paired timing shows no attributable runtime benefit. This does not justify adding alias-lifetime complexity to the production default solely for performance.

invariant_assessment.04_compact_persistent_state: NEUTRAL; no per-column persistent state changes
invariant_assessment.05_scratch_per_worker: PASS; existing forcing caches were worker-owned and direct views remain worker-scoped
invariant_assessment.07_transactional_steps: PASS in scientific qualification, but requires explicit view lifetime discipline
invariant_assessment.29_no_silent_dependencies: MORE_COMPLEX; safe only with explicit TARGET/view lifetime contract

recommended_disposition: DO_NOT_RETAIN_CANDIDATE_PRODUCTION_SOURCE; preserve scientific and timing evidence, restore PE09 production postimage
